name: Moloni ON
author: Moloni

sections.description:
Moloni ON is a 100% online management and billing software, modular and scalable, designed to adapt to the pace of each business.
With an intuitive interface, it allows you to issue documents, manage customers, and automate processes in a personalized way, subscribing only to the tools you need.

Certified under no. 3075 by the Tax Authority, it ensures full legal compliance and maximum security in the cloud.

With our integration, your business benefits from:

  • Full synchronization: Products and stock always up to date across both platforms.
  • Smart invoicing: Automatic issuance and sending of various types of documents to customers.
  • Centralised management: Access to documents and warehouse control without leaving WordPress.
  • Data automation: Automatic creation of customers and products.
  • Specialised support: Support provided directly by Moloni’s Customer Support team.
sections.installation: This plugin can be installed via FTP or using the WordPress plugin installer.
sections.faq:
Is there a paid version of the plugin?

No. The plugin was developed and is made available completely free.

How much will I have to pay for support?

Like the Moloni software, all support is completely free and provided entirely by our Moloni Customer Support team.

Documents are being issued without a taxpayer number

By default, WooCommerce does not have a taxpayer/VAT field. Usually, you add another plugin that provides a taxpayer/VAT number field for the customer.

These plugins create a custom_field associated with the customer’s billing address, such as _billing_vat.

Once you have such a plugin installed, select in the Moloni On plugin settings which custom_field corresponds to the customer’s taxpayer/VAT number.
